full_description: there are three colored blocks on the table, <move the blocks to the center of the table>, and <stack them in the order given by the instruction>
schema: {A} notifies the block placed at the center of the table, {B} notifies the block stacked on {A}, {C} notifies the block stacked on {B}, {a}, {b} and {c} notify the arms used to manipulate {A}, {B} and {C}. The stacking order is randomized per episode, the per action instructions are generated separately from description/subtask_instruction/stack_blocks_three_atomic.json
preference: fixed single instruction matching BT output
seen: Stack the blocks on top of each other in the order {A}, {B}, {C} starting from the bottom.
unseen: Stack the blocks on top of each other in the order {A}, {B}, {C} starting from the bottom.
